comments: ~What kind of device? Is that a USB key or a phone storage?~ just seen the Android folder xD
@josh-65 could you confirm that the issue is only for folder icons while file icons are shown?
Yes, seem to be folders only.
This issue should be resolved with #6484.

review_comments: In the case where an exception is thrown everytime - this will cause performance issue.
Added exception handling, increased size to 80 (this placeholder is gonna be used for large grid too), moved the call to BaseLayout. Do you see any issue with this?
Seems good to me. Will this solve the slight shifting that happens when the actual thumbnail loads?
I don't see any shifting (also before this change), only in details view there's a flickering (is that the one?) when the true thumbnails load.

After testing it out, it looks a little odd to switch to a lower scale icon when the thumbnail finishes loading in the details layout. Posible solutions would be to have different scale placeholder icons or we can increase the scaling we use for in the details layout to 80 so we get a sharper thumbnail all the time.

Uoa you can see the difference 😮?  Different scale placeholders would be the definitive solution as 80 does not look particularly better than 40 in large gridview mode (size: 300) but I think it's good like this for now.
